name: Content creators and influencer businesses
sector: 7.M Digital economy, social and public sector

problems.words: Brands pay months late, some never pay
quick_ideas: List every unpaid invoice once with its date and brand, so you see who to chase first
Agree payment terms in writing before starting the next deal, so there is something to point to.

workzap_build.text: a receivables board showing what each brand owes and for how long, with automatic payment reminders to the brand's finance contact.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many brands owe you at the moment?
problems.free_stops: The reminder schedule and board set-up are detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare unpaid brand invoices by how long they have sat since delivery, so you see which follow ups are hurting cash most.
Give one person a fixed weekly slot to chase unpaid invoices from one written list, so collections stop slipping behind.

problems.words: I don't know which brand owes me what right now
quick_ideas: Pull every live deal out of email and WhatsApp into one sheet with its stage
Mark each deal as posted, invoiced or paid, so the gaps are obvious.

workzap_build.text: a brand deal tracker from enquiry to paid, with each deal's stage and ageing in one place.

problems.free_stops: The deal stages and how deals flow into invoicing are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write every live brand deal and what is still owed on one page, so you can see the total outstanding at a glance.
Give one person the job of updating one notebook page after each brand message, so what is owed stays current.

problems.words: Deliverables and deadlines are all over WhatsApp groups
quick_ideas: Put every agreed deliverable and go-live date into one shared calendar
Share that calendar with your editor, so both of you see the same dates.

workzap_build.text: a deliverables calendar with go-live dates and approval rounds, sending WhatsApp reminders to you and your editor.

problems.free_stops: The calendar structure and reminder timings are covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many live deliverables still have no deadline written in one place, so missed posting dates become visible.
Give one person the job of writing every agreed deliverable and deadline into one notebook, so handoffs stop getting missed.

problems.words: Brand asked for endless revisions and I had no limit agreed
quick_ideas: Agree the number of approval rounds before starting each deal
Keep a simple count of revisions per deal, so you can raise it when it runs over.

workzap_build.text: an approval tracker that logs each revision round per deal and flags when the agreed limit is reached.

problems.free_stops: How rounds are logged and flagged goes in the solution document; contract wording is for your lawyer.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many times each brand deal came back for changes this month, so you see which jobs are eating edit time.
Give one person the job of logging every revision request in one list, so repeated changes are easier to raise early.

problems.words: Forgot I was exclusive with one brand
quick_ideas: Write down the exclusivity and usage end dates from each current agreement in one list
Check that list before saying yes to any new brand.

workzap_build.text: a terms register for exclusivity windows, usage periods and whitelisting end dates, with alerts before each one expires.

problems.free_stops: The register fields and alert rules are prepared in the solution document; interpreting terms is for your lawyer.

extra_ideas.text: Check current brand agreements for any exclusivity or usage end dates not written in one place, so unclear contract terms stand out.
Give one person the job of checking one exclusivity list before accepting new brand work, so clashes are caught earlier.

problems.words: Inbound brand emails get lost in my DMs
quick_ideas: Point brands to one email or form in your bio, so enquiries arrive in one place
Reply to every new enquiry within a fixed time, even if only to say you'll come back.

workzap_build.text: an enquiry form on your link-in-bio page that sorts brand requests into one inbox with follow-up reminders.

problems.free_stops: The form and sorting set-up are designed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many brand enquiries from this week sit unanswered across messages and inboxes, so you see the follow up backlog clearly.
Give one person one daily time to note every new brand enquiry in one list, so replies stop getting buried.

problems.words: Brand asks for insights screenshots each time and I make reports by hand
quick_ideas: Save insights screenshots into a folder per campaign right after posting
Keep one standard report layout, so each report starts from the same base.

workzap_build.text: a campaign report builder that compiles screenshots and figures into a branded PDF for each brand.

problems.free_stops: The report layout and how figures are gathered are covered in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many past campaign posts are missing saved insights screenshots, so you see which reports will take longer to assemble.
Give one person the job of saving campaign screenshots into one labelled place after posting, so report prep gets less scattered.

problems.words: Editor delivers late so posting is inconsistent
quick_ideas: Give the editor a due date for every piece, not just the go-live date
Check once a week which pieces are late and why.

workzap_build.text: an editor task board with due dates, revision counts and handoff status, with reminders before each deadline.

problems.free_stops: The board and its reminders are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare promised edit handover dates with actual delivery dates for recent pieces, so you see how often posting plans get knocked.
Give one person the job of confirming each edit handover time in one list, so late pieces are caught before posting slips.

problems.words: Income swings — great months then nothing
quick_ideas: Note last year's income by month and source, so the slow months are visible
Line up deals early for the known brand-budget peaks like Ramadan and year-end.

workzap_build.text: a revenue view by source and month showing seasonality and expected payments.

problems.free_stops: The view and its inputs are detailed in the solution document; money planning is for your accountant.

extra_ideas.text: Note which months brought little brand income and which income sources filled the gaps, so quieter periods are easier to plan around.
Give one person one weekly time to list expected deal payments in one notebook, so lean periods are spotted earlier.

problems.words: Footage on random drives — lost a full shoot once
quick_ideas: Pick one place where every shoot is copied the same day
Keep a second copy of anything not yet delivered.

workzap_build.text: an asset library structure with backup reminders after every shoot.

problems.free_stops: The folder structure and backup routine go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many shoots still sit on random drives without a second copy, so you see which footage is at risk now.
Give one person the job of noting every shoot's storage place in one notebook, so missing footage is quicker to trace.

never_say: Promises of growth, virality, follower numbers or brand rates.
Legal advice on contracts, exclusivity, IP, defamation or disclosure — say "talk to a lawyer".
Advice on UAE advertiser licensing or tax on brand income — say "check with the licensing authority or your accountant".
Help with buying followers, fake giveaways, undisclosed paid promotion or copying others' content.
Asking for children's names, ages or schools in family content, or for account passwords.

sample_reply.person: Can you help me sort out chasing brands for payment? It's killing me.
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this is very fixable, and you can start this week. 1) List every unpaid invoice once with its date and brand, so you know exactly who to chase first. 2) Agree payment terms in writing before your next deal starts, so there's something clear to point to. Workzap can do the tracking automatically for you: one board showing what each brand owes and for how long, with reminders sent on schedule. Would you like me to prepare a solution document and quote for you? You're welcome to say no.
